definitions.explanation: Frequency modulation radio broadcasting, which offers higher audio quality than AM radio.

examples.japanese: FM{放送|ほうそう}を{聴|き}く。
{車|くるま}でFM{局|きょく}を{探|さが}した。
examples.english: I searched for an FM station in the car.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}ではFMの{電波|でんぱ}が{届|とど}きにくい。
examples.english: FM signals are hard to receive in this area.

notes:
FM stands for frequency modulation ({周波数|しゅうはすう}{変調|へんちょう}). It offers better sound quality than AM but has shorter range.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- FM{放送|ほうそう}: FM broadcasting
- FM{局|きょく}: FM station
- FM{番組|ばんぐみ}: FM program
- FM{ラジオ|らじお}: FM radio

JAPANESE FM STATIONS:
Japan has numerous FM stations including:
- {地上波|ちじょうは}FM: terrestrial FM (76.1-94.9 MHz)
- コミュニティFM: community FM stations
- J-WAVE, FM802, FM{東京|とうきょう} are popular stations
